Caller audit (not guessed, code-cited): GAS T2_F2Import.js sets narx_yoq correctly (safe); both Tizim_02 frontend paths (TestF2Import.tsx, TestF2.tsx) never send it and sb-yoz.ts stripped it even if they did (frontend fix: sb-yoz.ts/supabase.ts now pass narx_yoq through, zero behavior change until a caller opts in) -- see T2_BRIDGE_CALLER_AUDIT_003.md Part A. codex/t2-lrv-canonical-core-v1 (bbf55c8) reconciled: semantics ACCEPTED in full, but its 11 new t2_lrv_* tables were parallel-truth REJECTed as tables and ADAPTed onto t2_qator/t2_akt_qator/t2_ish_turi instead (T2_LRV_EXACT_F2_INTEGRATION_003.md Section 3) -- its sync-event/conflict envelope became 20260920140000 (generic entity_table+entity_id, schema only, GAS writer not touched).
